name: BS-2550 Battery Back-up
spec: 600 VA · 150–250 V in, 220 V out · 8 × 3.2 V / 6 Ah LiFePO₄ · motors to 400 kg
text: Lithium iron phosphate rather than lead-acid: 2,000 charge cycles against 500, and above 80% of rated capacity at the end of them. Standby is 32 to 48 hours. Case 281 × 195 × 58 mm, with overload and short-circuit protection.
